items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Well, today, if you don't give a man Todd Billing, he might walk out on you.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that's more honest than the way they do things now sometimes. I don't know.
Well, today, if you don't give a man Todd Billing, he might walk out on you.

Yeah. Well, I mean, sometimes you need to know who the producer of a show is. Because they, guys, they had certain reputations. Right. And some producers had integrity and some of them didn't. Some guys, you know, it seemed to me that they're good producers. They deserve a lot of credit. Right. People don't realize that. Just like a lot of people don't think a band leader does anything. They don't know what he does after the show is open, before it goes on.
